description: Covers a medicine's uses, warnings, recalls and shortages by brand or generic name. The US label can be checked for mentions of a second medicine, food, alcohol or pregnancy. Choose Canada or an EU country for local records. For device or recall-only searches, use Recalls.

country.description: Country for the label; defaults to the US

include_cost.description: Include US pharmacy acquisition costs when asked

name.description: Brand or generic name, e.g. 'Advil' or 'metformin'

with.description: Medicine, food, alcohol, pregnancy or breastfeeding to check in the US label

name: check_medicine
title: Medicine: labels, interactions, recalls
